safety.descriptionHint: What happened, in your own words

family.subtitle: Involve the people whose judgement you trust.
family.inviteBody: A parent, sibling or guardian. They receive an invitation and create their own account - they never share yours, and they never see your password.
family.permissionsBody: Each permission is granted one at a time and can be taken back instantly. Nobody sees your contact details, your exact location, or anything you have not shared with them.
family.reviewTitle: They approve before anyone can talk
family.reviewBody: If you choose it, a match waits for their approval before a conversation can begin. You can change the setting or remove them whenever you want - what you cannot do is approve on their behalf, because that is what makes the approval mean something.
family.privacyNote: Everything a family member looks at is recorded and shown to you.
family.gateBody: When this is on, a new match cannot become a conversation until someone you trust approves it. You can turn it off again at any time. What you cannot do is approve your own match — that is what makes the approval mean something.
family.gateNoReviewers: Nobody can approve yet. Invite someone and give them the approval permission, or every new match will wait with no way to open it.
family.membersEmpty: You have not invited anyone yet.
family.revokeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They lose every permission immediately. Any review they were asked for stays pending, so nothing is approved or rejected on their way out.
family.inviteContactHint: They receive a link and create their own account.
family.tierObserverBody: They see what you have chosen to share, and nothing else.
family.tierReviewerBody: Everything above, plus they can approve or decline a match before a conversation starts, and report or block on your behalf.
family.inviteTokenOnce: Share this link with them now. For their safety it is shown once and cannot be retrieved later — if you lose it, cancel the invitation and send a new one.
family.inviteShareMessage: Assalamu alaikum. I would like you to join my family on NikahMate. Open this link in the app to accept: {{link}}
family.joinBody: Accepting makes you a family member of the person who sent you this link, with the access they chose for you. Only accept a link from someone you know.
family.joinPasteBody: Paste the invitation link you were sent.
family.joinInvalidLink: That does not look like a NikahMate invitation link. Paste the whole link you were sent.
family.joinNotFound: This invitation is no longer valid. It may have been used or cancelled. Ask for a new one.
family.joinExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
family.joinOwn: You cannot accept an invitation you sent yourself.
family.reviewsEmpty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
family.packetReported: This person has been reported before
family.packetNoContact: You are seeing what is needed to make this decision. Contact details, exact location and private messages are never shown to family.
family.myReviewStalled: This has been waiting more than 3 days. You can remove this family member or turn family review off — you do not need their agreement to do either.
family.accessActionOpened: Opened a match to review it
family.accessActionAskedMore: Asked for more information about a match
family.accessLogNote: Every time someone you invited looks at something, it is recorded here with the permission that allowed it.
family.errorLoad: Could not load your family settings.
family.errorSave: That did not save. Please try again.
family.invitationCancelBody: The link you shared will stop working.
family.withdrawBody: Messages between them will close. What has already been said stays readable.

chat.title: Messages
chat.subtitle: Conversations with the people you have matched with.
chat.emptyBody: When a match is open, your conversation appears here. If your family reviews matches, it begins after they approve.
chat.leaveConfirm: Leave this conversation? You will stop receiving messages. This does not end the match — you can do that from the match itself.
chat.blockConfirm: Block this person? You will no longer be able to message each other, and neither of you will see the other in Discover.
chat.closedPending_family_review: Waiting for family approval before this conversation can begin.
chat.closedFamily_rejected: Your family declined this match, so messages are closed.
chat.closedFamily_revoked: Family approval was withdrawn. You can still read what was said.
chat.closedBlocked: Messages are closed because of a block.
chat.closedMatch_ended: This match has ended. You can still read what was said.
chat.closedCounterpart_left: The other person has left this conversation. It is closed for both of you.
chat.closedRead_only: You can read this conversation but not write in it.
chat.errorSend: That message did not send. Please try again.
chat.unmatchConfirm: End this match? Messages will close for both of you. You can still read what was said.
chat.errorAction: That didn't work. Please try again.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.explanation: Our moderation team has suspended this account. While it is suspended you can't use NikahMate, and other members can't see your profile.
suspended.nextStep: There is nothing you can do in the app to change this. You can sign out, or ask for your account to be deleted.

banned.title: Your account is banned
banned.explanation: Our moderation team has banned this account. You can't use NikahMate with it, and other members can't see your profile.
banned.nextStep: There is nothing you can do in the app to change this. You can sign out, or ask for your account to be deleted.

deactivated.title: Your account is deactivated
deactivated.explanation: This account has been deactivated, so your profile is hidden and you can't use NikahMate with it. Nothing has been deleted.
deactivated.nextStep: Reactivate your account to pick up where you left off.

pendingDeletion.title: Your account is scheduled for deletion
pendingDeletion.explanation: A request to delete this account is open. Your profile is hidden, and you can't use NikahMate with this account while the request is open.
pendingDeletion.nextStep: If you change your mind, you can cancel the request now and keep your account.
pendingDeletion.scheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}.
pendingDeletion.held: A safety review on this account must finish before it can be deleted.

unknown.title: Your account isn't available
unknown.explanation: This account can't use NikahMate at the moment.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.intro: Please read this first. Here is what happens if you go ahead.

point.hidden: Your profile is hidden from other members straight away, and you can't use NikahMate with this account while the request is open.
point.grace: You have {{days}} days to change your mind. Sign in and choose "Keep my account" to cancel the request.
point.erased: After that, your name, date of birth, private details and photos are removed for good.
point.kept: Messages you have sent stay in the other person's conversation, no longer linked to you. Some safety and legal records are kept for a limited time.
point.held: If a safety review is open on your account, deletion waits until it has finished.

account.savedHint: People you saved to come back to

account.blockedHint: See who you have blocked, or unblock them
account.blockedEmptyBody: If you block someone, they will be listed here.
account.unblockBody: You will be able to see each other again, and they will not be told.
account.reportsHint: Reports you have made, and where they stand
account.reportsEmptyBody: If you report someone, you can follow it here.
